title: Write 15+ unit tests for three validation categories' boundary conditions
description: Create src-ts/tests/mcp/input-validation.test.ts with at least 15 unit tests covering validateStringLength, safeResolveWorkspaceRoot, and validateWeight boundary conditions including edge cases.
action: Create src-ts/tests/mcp/input-validation.test.ts with vitest describe/it blocks. Test cases: validateStringLength — (1) null return for string within limit, (2) 413 response for string exceeding limit, (3) 413 response for empty string with limit 0, (4) null for exactly-at-limit string, (5) correct error message includes label and maxLength. safeResolveWorkspaceRoot — (6) returns cwd when env not set, (7) returns resolved path for valid subdir of allowed root, (8) throws on path traversal with ../, (9) throws on absolute path outside allowed root, (10) handles whitespace-only env value. validateWeight — (11) null for valid weight in [0,1], (12) 400 for NaN, (13) 400 for Infinity, (14) 400 for -Infinity, (15) 400 for value < min, (16) 400 for value > max, (17) null for value exactly 0, (18) null for value exactly 1

criteria: npx vitest run src-ts/tests/mcp/input-validation.test.ts passes with 0 failures
convergence.definition_of_done: 15+ unit tests covering all three validators' boundary conditions, all passing

files.change: Create test file with 15+ test cases for three validation functions

implementation: Import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest'
Write describe('validateStringLength', ...) with 5 test cases: within limit, over limit, empty string at limit 0, exact limit boundary, error message format

Write describe('safeResolveWorkspaceRoot', ...) with 5 test cases: env not set returns cwd, valid subdir resolves, path traversal with ../ throws, absolute path outside root throws, whitespace-only env returns cwd — use beforeEach/afterEach to save/restore NIKO_WORKFLOW_WORKSPACE env

Write describe('validateWeight', ...) with 8 test cases: valid in range, NaN returns 400, Infinity returns 400, -Infinity returns 400, below min returns 400, above max returns 400, exactly 0 passes, exactly 1 passes
Run tests: npx vitest run src-ts/tests/mcp/input-validation.test.ts

reference.pattern: Vitest describe/it/expect pattern from existing test files

rationale.chosen_approach: Dedicated test file for the shared module ensures coverage before downstream tasks rely on it. Boundary conditions (NaN, Infinity, exact limits, path traversal patterns) are critical for security validation.
decision_factors: 15+ tests required by roadmap success criteria
Boundary conditions are where security bugs hide
Test-first for shared module reduces risk for downstream tasks

risks.risk: safeResolveWorkspaceRoot tests need to manipulate process.env which may affect other tests if not cleaned up
risks.mitigation: Use beforeEach/afterEach to save and restore NIKO_WORKFLOW_WORKSPACE env var
